<title
    level="1"
    right="Feat 17"
    pfs="Standard"
>
[Nodal Regeneration](/Feats.aspx?ID=5398) <actions string="" />
</title>

<traits>
<trait label="Surki" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=789" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Howl of the Wild](/Sources.aspx?ID=226) pg. 51

**Prerequisites**
[Nodal Healing](/Feats.aspx?ID=5394)

</column>

---

Your body processes magic so effectively that you can induce true regeneration, replacing limbs and restoring organs. You can cast [_regenerate_](/Spells.aspx?ID=1648) once per day as an innate spell. Instead of being deactivated by acid or fire, your regeneration from the spell is deactivated by [cold](/Traits.aspx?ID=555), which slows your metabolism. You can target only yourself with the spell, but you can Cast the Spell as a reaction if you're reduced to 0 Hit Points by a non-cold effect.
name: Nodal Regeneration
